svg.text: How a statement flows through quarrydb

g.text: sql/lexer.py → tokens sql/parser.py → AST (sql/ast.py) sqlgen.py → SQL text for EXPLAIN / DEFAULT / CHECK
Hand-written tokenizer and recursive-descent parser with SQLite precedence rules; statements are cached per connection.
sql/executor.py access paths: rowid lookup › index equality › rowid range › index range › scan; predicate push-down; EXPLAIN
sql/compiler.py expressions → Python closures (row mode / group mode), correlated subqueries via a shared outer-row cell
sql/values.py · sql/functions.py three-valued logic, affinity, LIKE/GLOB, 60 scalar + 8 aggregate functions
catalog.py tables, columns, indexes and AUTOINCREMENT sequences in a system B+tree (JSON values)
btree.py B+tree: splits, merges on delete, linked leaves for range scans, overflow chains for large values
encoding.py varint row records; order-preserving keys (NULL < numbers < text < blob, ints and reals interleave)
pager.py 4 KiB pages, header, free list, page cache, advisory file lock, statement-level undo journal
write-ahead log: CRC-checked frames + commit marker, fsync, replay or discard on open
commit = flush nodes → append frames to WAL → fsync → write main file → fsync → truncate WAL
read / write / allocate / free / commit / rollback
